subject: @iachilles/memento 0.7.0
why: CONTROL, not a new subject. memento already has a hand-written adapter in harness.py; this manifest exists so the declarative path can be checked against it. If both produce the same verdicts, the manifest mechanism is equivalent to hand-written code; if they differ, one of them is wrong and the difference is the bug. Observations live in a separate table here, so no content column is declared and on-disk length stays unmeasured.
